◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.

killerTaleLog: [day 23] Sofia: The fire settles. Sofia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Drum-Belly — I put it down today." "It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Henry says quietly "Say that again — slower." Hine breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 23] Hine: The fire settles. Hine has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Rut King — I put it down today." "He lowers the crown. Paws the earth once, twice. The whole forest holds its breath." "His chest swells. The inhale goes on too long — cover your ears or get behind something." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ingrid asks "So it bleeds." Oliver says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 25] Ingrid: The fire settles. Ingrid has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Union Rep — I put it down today." "'BROTHERS! SISTERS!' Allied monsters hit harder. The speech is the weapon." "'WHO'S WITH ME?' Help is coming." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Sofia asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Jasper says "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 30] Sofia: The fire settles. Sofia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Performance Review — I put it down today." "A red line draws itself across the ground. 3.2 stars. 'ASSESSMENT IN PROGRESS.' Do not be on the line." "It stamps the air. REJECTED. The word has weight." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Raj says "We've been walking past those." Ingrid breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 30] Oliver: The fire settles. Oliver has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Grief Counselor — I put it down today." "It turns. On its brow, like a mask: YOUR FACE. It lowers its head. It is going to show you yourself, at speed." "You dodged — it WHEELS. A second charge, no windup, aimed at where you are NOW." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Chester mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Crimthann says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 33] Raj: The fire settles. Raj has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Static — I put it down today." "It finds your voice in the static. It WEARS it. 'Help— help me—' in YOUR voice. Moving won't help once it has you." "It drops the voice. No static, no words — it RUSHES, no telegraph at all. Back off." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Jasper asks "The fire feels smaller now." Crimthann asks "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 38] Chester: The fire settles. Chester has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Spool — I put it down today." "RECORD first — harmless, it watches. Then REPLAY: the reels on its back spin, and the spinning reel SHOWS what's loaded. Watch the reel, not the tape." "RECORD. The reels turn slowly, drinking in everything you do. It is learning the shape of your turns." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Jasper says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Priya says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 42] Ingrid: The fire settles. Ingrid has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nostalgia — I put it down today." "The air fills with light — YOUR memories, projected huge. The beam follows your gaze. MOVE." "The reel stutters — outtakes. Embarrassing ones. Close up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Chester says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Henry breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 42] Oliver: The fire settles. Oliver has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Priya breathes "Say that again — slower." Raj asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 52] Oliver: The fire settles. Oliver has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Ad Break — I put it down today." "A giant floating AD glyph with a PROGRESS BAR — the bar is the telegraph. During the pause it repositions and heals, and you watch. After the bar fills, a 'skip ad' beat appears: skip faster if the audience likes you. Or look away — the ad's power is that you WATCH." "A glowing can rotates beside it — ‘THIS REGENERATION BROUGHT TO YOU BY—’ It drinks. It heals." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Mia says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Ingrid mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 57] Hine: The fire settles. Hine has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Focus Group — I put it down today." "The murmur rises — you can HEAR them deliberating. They're about to love your dodge and hate your strike. The ratings are honest and visible." "The lead mouth-head clears its throat — the opening question, focus-grouped and focus-grouped again: ‘So... how does that make you FEEL?’" A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Chester mutters "So it bleeds." Crimthann breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 61] Hine: The fire settles. Hine has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Raj says "We've been walking past those." Ingrid says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 61] Oliver: The fire settles. Oliver has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Paparazzo — I put it down today." "The flash charges — whine rising. When it fires, you freeze in place." "Every shot refines its model — hit or miss. At 4, the money shot is unavoidable." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Henry says "Did it look at you? Before?" Hine says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 80] Ingrid: The fire settles. Ingrid has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Hine asks "So it bleeds." Henry says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 102] Chester: The fire settles. Chester has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Lockpick — I put it down today." "It sits up. Its hands move too fast to follow. Something you own is suddenly in its hands." "Cornered, it shows its teeth. It fights second — but it fights." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Henry breathes "And you're still standing." Giulia says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 102] Chester: The fire settles. Chester has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sunbasker — I put it down today." "Its scales go from dull brown to molten gold. Heat shimmers off its back. It's ready." "It goes still in the sun. Gold spreads across its back — the charge is building." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Henry asks "And you're still standing." Mia mutters "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 127] Deo: The fire settles. Deo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Terms of Service — I put it down today." "The text on the scroll GLOWS before a clause activates — the glow runs along the words like a fuse. The telegraph is literally legible. Reading is the defense." "A new paragraph slides in at the bottom — §12.4, freshly inked. You definitely didn’t agree to this. You also definitely did." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Chester breathes "And you're still standing." Hine asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 136] Deo: The fire settles. Deo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Herald — I put it down today." "It raises its trumpet. A line of sky goes WHITE — that's where the sound will land. MOVE." "It turns, slowly, and TWO patches of sky go white. It is showing you where NOT to stand. Split up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Kupe says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Mia breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 138] Kupe: The fire settles. Kupe has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Extended Warranty — I put it down today." "RING. RING. The sound is inside your skull. 'We have been trying to REACH you about your—'" "It dials faster. More voices. All of them want to talk about your coverage." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Hine asks "We've been walking past those." Deo mutters "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 144] Kupe: The fire settles. Kupe has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hummice — I put it down today." "A low hum rises from the grass. It harmonizes with itself. Your teeth ache." "Teeth in the grass, everywhere at once — a tide of small bites." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Henry asks "And you're still standing." Hine says "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
